717	          "problem": "MoE LLMs have massive weights (95-98% of parameters) and dynamic computation that impede efficient serving. Existing instance-level prefill-decode disaggregation (PDD) isolates phases on separate full-model replicas, each spanning tens to hundreds of GPUs, making resource allocation increasingly coarse. Configured prefill-to-decode ratios often mismatch demand. Prefill-decode colocation solutions using Green Context partition each GPU by phase and fix phase resources during a kernel, unable to track resource changes across operations or layerwise variation in routed expert load, causing head-of-line blocking or idle reserved resources.",
